Question B-001-015-008.

Why the correct answer is right: The Canadian 20-metre band range is 14.000 MHz to 14.350 MHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "13.500 MHz to 14.000 MHz": This range stops where the 20-metre range begins and leaves out the 14.000 MHz to 14.350 MHz segment.
- sourceIndex 2: "15.000 MHz to 15.750 MHz": This range is above the 20-metre band and does not overlap 14.000 MHz to 14.350 MHz.
- sourceIndex 3: "16.350 MHz to 16.830 MHz": This range is also above the 14.000 MHz to 14.350 MHz 20-metre allocation.
